verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe a built-in AI agent that helps users design and animate. It can generate responsive layouts, data models and animation, and MCP tools let AI create layouts and shapes directly in the Editor. Together these cover generating and editing real design content from agent prompts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language prompting for full mockups or first drafts, detail on how the agent edits existing designs, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Rive's AI agent helps you write code, design, and animate. Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.
The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
Build interactive UI, motion, and game experiences in the Editor, or let an agent generate them with the CLI.
